return_comparison_scope.density: SPAN_RETURN_FINE vs SPAN_RETURN_COARSE: same analytic recipe, fixed 18 field iterations, fraction .18 and authored return schedule; sampled input density changes.
return_comparison_scope.staged_field: SPAN_RETURN_COARSE vs SPAN_RETURN_STAGED: same coarse input, fraction .18 and authored returns; the finite escape iteration schedule is read from each saved stage. This is not guaranteed low-pass filtering.
return_comparison_scope.fold_provenance: Scheduled returns are authored smooth_deep PCHIP geometry, not spontaneous IAAC field folds. Actual logged parameters are retained per stage.

scope: Actual saved previews and small generation metadata only. SPAN coarse/refined changes target sampling with the same declared input and field; WEAVE bridge4 changes both input and field and is a design comparison. Control movement fractions exclude render-only face centres. Our finite initial forms and field settings do not recover undisclosed IAAC code or numerical parameters.
